statement: Every automated Toolkit launch of a G0/G1/G2 worker, successor or permitted helper meets the shared pre-inference invariants in repo/scripts/toolkit-v3-launch-assurance.cjs, each through its own host adapter or launcher. ENFORCED means shipped code enforces the invariant on that path; evidence SOURCE_TEST means in-process tests, PROCESS the real hook or launcher process without the host, NATIVE the real host, INSTALLED an installed consumer. Hook paths account for every guard-failure layer. Native qualification is a separate field, not raised here; superseded claims stay in its history.

GUARD_FAILURE.reason: Claude Code 2.1.301 runs a PreToolUse hook that cannot start, crashes, exits non-zero other than 2 or times out, and a missing hook, as non-blocking unless the handler sets onFailure block (Claude Code 2.1.295 and later). Toolkit 3.1.0 registers onFailure block on the Agent|Task hook only; that host behaviour is not yet native-tested on this candidate. Errors inside the hook deny in governed work; outside governed work (shared predicate in toolkit-governed-repo.cjs) the hook makes no decision. Launched workers carry a host deny rule.

failure_layers.basis: Any error inside the decision is caught and written as a JSON deny (PROCESS; host blocks a JSON deny on exit 0, NATIVE I1).

Decision modules load inside the guarded path; in governed work a missing decision module is a handled deny. Without the shared predicate module only a launcher marker gates (PROCESS test on copies with and without the predicate).

NATIVE S1, 19 Oct 2026 (before onFailure): a hook-process error (exit 1, missing script) is non-blocking, so the tool ran. 3.1.0 registers onFailure block, documented to block on start failure and non-0/2 exits; native recheck with a missing script is pending, so the layer stays HELD. Launched workers: host deny rule.

NATIVE S1 (before onFailure): exceeding the registered hook timeout gives outcome cancelled and the tool ran. onFailure block is documented to cover a timeout; native recheck pending. Same protection split as a crash.
No per-hook trust step; a disabled plugin or absent hook runs nothing. The Desktop entry loads the orphaned 2.10.14 hook, which allows every Agent call under broader-native (receipt case 13).
Agent|Task matches the observed native name: hook input names the tool Agent although stream init lists Task (NATIVE I1).

GUARD_FAILURE.reason: Codex continues the tool when a PreToolUse hook fails, exits non-zero other than 2, times out, returns unsupported output, or is untrusted or disabled (codex-rs 0.163.0-alpha.9 hooks pre_tool_use.rs; the installed build is 0.163.0-alpha.10.2). Errors the hook can see deny with exit 2. The uncontrolled native path needs an owner-approved disable of the native collab tools.

failure_layers.basis: Decision errors deny; the hook writes the reason on stderr with exit 2, which Codex blocks on (PROCESS).

Decision modules load inside the guarded path; a copy with the shared governed-repo predicate but without its decision modules denies with exit 2 in the governed checkout. Without the predicate only a launcher marker gates (PROCESS).
Host source: a failed run or a non-2 exit code is recorded as a failed hook and the tool continues.
Host source: hook timed out is a failed hook run, not a block.

Untrusted, changed or disabled hooks are skipped. Changing this matcher changes the hook hash, so 3.0.9 needs owner re-trust of the corrected definition. The registration acceptance check (verifyCodexHelperRegistration on hooks/list output) is run manually or by a qualification harness; no production launcher calls it.

Both hooks.json matchers equal CODEX_SPAWN_MATCHER, which the recogniser is built from, over the host namespace alphabet [A-Za-z0-9_-] (codex-rs 0.163.0-alpha.9). Default, V1, collaboration, hyphenated and configured names are matched and held unless bound (SOURCE_TEST; PROCESS exit 2); registration checks probe hyphenated and configured namespaces. G2 F1: the first 3.0.9 matcher omitted - (multi-agentspawn_agent admitted, exit 0). NATIVE 19 Oct 2026: installed 3.0.8 missed collaborationspawn_agent. Candidate matcher not native-tested.

GUARD_FAILURE.reason: Errors inside the in-process V1 hooks hold task, observer timeouts deny and a missing or drifted helper runtime holds task. With no project plugin loaded the native task tool runs unguarded, and the host's handling of a plugin that fails to load is unobserved. A primary-session task backstop for when the plugin is absent, disabled or fails to import is HELD (OPENCODE_PRIMARY_TASK_BACKSTOP_UNVERIFIED): the candidate project-scoped permission.task deny is specified in the installation proposal but its OpenCode 1.18.32 semantics are unconfirmed and nothing is installed.

failure_layers.basis: tool.execute.before throws a held error before task effects; observer calls have a bounded deadline (SOURCE_TEST).
Runtime modules are digest-checked before loading; missing, drifted or observer-less setups return hooks that hold task (SOURCE_TEST on the rendered plugin).
The plugin runs in the host process; how OpenCode 1.18.32 treats a plugin file that fails to parse or import is unobserved.
No host-imposed V1 hook deadline is known; the plugin's own observer deadline is 150 ms.
